findings.summary: The right-triangle formulas used shortened Italian side labels instead of the established cateto opposto and cateto adiacente terms.
evidence: The explanatory text used cateto opposto and cateto adiacente while the formulas displayed only opposto and adiacente.
findings.resolution: Expanded all three visible formulas to the established Italian side terminology.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas used shortened Italian side labels that differed from the surrounding explanation.
evidence: The inverse formulas omitted cateto although the section used the full Italian side terms.
findings.resolution: Aligned all three inverse formulas with the established Italian side terminology.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example used abbreviated side labels instead of the terms used in the Italian explanation.
evidence: The example labels omitted cateto while the surrounding text used cateto opposto and cateto adiacente.
findings.resolution: Expanded both example labels to cateto opposto and cateto adiacente.
